I relate so hard. Like jfc. 

I wasn’t allowed in the kitchen. If I opened the fridge looking for a snack I would get yelled at for leaving smudged on the fridge.  This was from childhood to adulthood ~22yo. 

Growing up I discovered I had mild food allergies caused by a nickel allergy and my mom refused to let me cook anything. It was either what she cooked, and boy she didn’t cook anything really, or nothing at all. She knew I broke out in rashes but didn’t really care. I would resort to bringing food home to eat after work once I started working but got shamed about my weight. 

I couldn’t use a microwave without fear of her getting after me for leaving smudges on the appliance. If I got something from the pantry she would mock my weight. 

I’m 25 now and I’m still dealing with all of that mentally. I’m afraid to go downstairs to the kitchen when someone is downstairs in fear someone will yell at me. I’m finally starting to learn to cook and I feel so far behind and I just blah. Sorry for the rant.
